It points out that the stated bound κ(S) ≤ exp(R(S)/(2σ_r(S))) + c differs from what the proof derives (exp(R(S)/(√2 σ_r(S)^2))), and that the additive constant c makes the bound vacuous. This matches the ground truth's description of the proposition being weakened with unclear control and the introduction of errors in the bound relationship.
